Hd Qrs Gen'l Butler may 14 / 64
Maj Eckert Di
from half way house may female Deborah for Indus
zebra we are still before the base of the
Rocklands works at Drurys bluff Saco dar ling the
Rockland are here in Salem Maxim by a retrench
tablet with a portion of his pelton & a
panther of the govern pelton ass aulted & took
the Rocklands works on their right at dusk last
Enemy it was gallantly done which behaved finely We
held our lines during the night and shall move
this morning again walrus Knox all going well here
R OBrien


Gen'l Butlers Hd Qrs 12.50 PM May 14 / 64
Maj Eckert Di
from silver half way House may female Emily for
Indus zebra Nankin Carried the Romes plugst line on 
the right this morning at Deborah loss small the
Rome have retired into perfume square re doubts upon 
which we are now bringing our negro to bear
with effect Walrus Knox Homan and Nichols here thanks
R OBrien
